text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: —All right! The lottery drawing is finally starting—! Are you all mentally prepared, everyoneee!!?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: We will be broadcasting the drawing live... Thank you so much... for all the entries...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The "Exciting☆ Win Special Gifts Chosen by Popular Horse Girls! Campaign♪" has finally begun!
choice_data_list: (Let's do my best helping with the stream!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! Falco's leading off as the first batter! Once again, Falco's present is~...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: An "Assorted Goods Pouch"☆ Photo prints, acrylic stands, stickers, and so much more—lots of autographed goods!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I really hope you use the pouch every day, too! Ehehe☆ Well then, let's do the draw!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Rattle-rattle-pop! And here it is!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Entry number 6048, Pyoi-ko-san! Congratulations~! Please take good care of it~~!

text_block_list.name: Viewer Comments
text_block_list.text:
"Ooooh! So jealous! Congrats!"
"There's still the participation prize (^^)/"
"The pouch is so stylish! Falco's got great taste"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Aha☆ Great taste? Really~? You see, while it looks simple at first glance, the material is super high-quality~...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Wah! The comment section is super hype☆ Falco-san, you're so good at generating positive qi~!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes, truly. Next... is Bourbon's turn, right? That present was quite surprising.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Right! But that's a great item from a feng shui perspective too♪ Plus, I can feel really wonderful qi coming from it☆

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Allow me to express my gratitude for the large number of entries. Regarding the item I selected—

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: The number of applicants for the music box... exceeded projections. Status: "Astonished."

text_block_list.name: Viewer Comments
text_block_list.text:
"Please let me win~!"
"I've been a fan forever, but that was so unexpected!"
"Does she like gentle sounds, I wonder...?"

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...While liking the melody is a factor, there was another catalyst.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: —The music player malfunctioned yet again. Verification of the data stating "music during muscle training increases efficiency"... failed.

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm... If only there were some analog way to listen to music...
...Oh, I know! How about that—?"

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...A music box, of all things...

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: However... detected appropriate muscular relaxation throughout the whole body. Focus and motivation have both increased...

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...A wondrous timbre. Despite being a metallic sound, it is soft...

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: —Since then, with my father's cooperation, I began collecting music boxes with various melodies.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: The music box chosen for this present is the exact same model as one of my particular favorites. In other words, "matching with me."

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Therefore, I considered that through this item, the winner would be able to direct their thoughts toward me.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...The above concludes my selection reasoning. Um... it is uncertain whether it will bring joy, but—

text_block_list.name: Viewer Comments
text_block_list.text: —"Th-That kind of thing..."

text_block_list.name: Viewer Comments
text_block_list.text:
"OF COURSE WE'D LOVE ITTT!"
"I want this! I want this so bad! Love you!!"
"She thought so hard about this for us... *cries*"

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: What a relief............

text_block_list.name: Viewer Comments
text_block_list.text:
"!!!!!!!!!!!!"
"BOURBONNNNNNN!!!"
"D-Digital is looking up at the heavens...!"

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: —Designated time reached. Concluding talk segment. Proceeding to lottery mission.
choice_data_list: (She went right back to her usual mode...!)

text_block_list.name: Viewer Comments
text_block_list.text:
"Waaaaait, I need to prepare myself mentally!"
"This is just Bourbon-san operating normally lol"
"Moving on so totally emotionless lmao"

text_block_list.name: Viewer Comments
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that's just like Bourbon!
I love everything about her, even this.
I'll keep cheering for you forever and ever!"

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Operation "Fan Appreciation Project." Mission complete.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Execution proceeded without delay. Judging from the comments, the fans also... appeared to be "joyful," according to estimates.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Knowing that a fan out there will possess the same item as me, listen to the same melody, and find joy in it...

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Status... let's see, yes... "Deeply moving."
